recent_articles.title: Bengali actors face heat after power shift to BJP; FIR filed over 2021 social media posts linked to post-poll violence - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parambrata Chatterjee**, a Bengali actor, announced he had to align with the **Trinamool Congress** after the recent West Bengal Assembly election results.  He stated this decision was made for his one-year-old son, prompting strong reactions from social media users and fellow actors. **Keya Ghosh**, a BJP leader, responded by criticizing Chatterjee's compromise and highlighting the unwavering support of many BJP supporters in the state.

recent_articles.title: Elected government has no role in Jammu demolitions, says Farooq Abdullah - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Farooq Abdullah**, president of the **National Conference (NC)**, stated that the elected government has no involvement in the ongoing demolitions in Jammu.  He accused the opposition parties of pursuing anti-Gujjar policies and claimed that Gujjars and Bakerwals have historically protected the region's borders. **Gulam Ali Khatana**, a BJP Rajya Sabha member, countered by accusing the NC and Congress of neglecting the development of Gujjar and Pahari communities for decades. He praised the Modi government's efforts to empower these communities.

recent_articles.title: Pakistan gets its own ‘Cockroach Awaam Party’ as India’s viral CJP sparks cross-border satire wave - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pakistan** has seen the emergence of satirical political groups inspired by the **Cockroach Janta Party**, a viral movement in India.  These groups, such as the **Cockroach Awami Party** and **Cockroach Awami League**, have emerged on social media platforms like Instagram and X, mirroring the Indian party's focus on issues affecting unemployed youth, including education, healthcare, and employment opportunities. The Pakistani groups use similar slogans and branding to their Indian counterparts, positioning themselves as alternative voices to mainstream political parties in Pakistan.

recent_articles.title: Meta and Snapchat blocking Saudi dissidents’ accounts | Social media | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Meta**, **Instagram**, and **X** have blocked accounts of Saudi Arabian dissidents, following orders from the Saudi government. The move has been met with criticism from human rights groups who argue that these companies are effectively silencing dissent and aiding in repression.  At least seven accounts were blocked by **Meta** at the end of April, including those of two American citizens and two individuals based in Europe. **Snapchat** appears to have slowed or removed some accounts without notifying users, while **X**, owned by **Elon Musk**, has informed some users that their content was blocked due to a request from the Saudi government.

recent_articles.title: 'Go home' for Green Card rule: Immigration attorney Rahul Reddy explains what H-1B visa holders should do now - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **USCIS** has issued a new memo that requires individuals seeking Green Cards to apply for visas in their home countries instead of adjusting status within the United States. The memo, which experts say may be challenged in court, emphasizes that approving Green Card applications from within the US is a "favor" and not a right.  The memo's impact on those who have already filed Green Card applications remains unclear, but it suggests individuals with pending I-140 petitions should consult legal counsel to strengthen their case.

recent_articles.title: US stocks today: Dow hits record high as Middle East hopes lift sentiment and Warsh takes Fed charge - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **S&P 500** closed at a new high, marking its eighth consecutive weekly gain.  **Semiconductor stocks** were mostly higher, driven by gains in Qualcomm and Lenovo Group's strong quarterly results. The **Federal Reserve** welcomed new Chair **Kevin Warsh**, while **Estee Lauder** rose after ending merger talks with **Puig**.   The **U.S.** made progress toward a deal with **Iran**, though more work remains according to **Secretary of State Marco Rubio**.

recent_articles.title: Will TVK government take ‘firm stand’ on Mekedatu project, asks Palaniswami - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, general secretary of the **AIADMK**, questioned the **Tamil Nadu** government's ability to protect its interests in the **Mekedatu balancing reservoir project** on the Cauvery river, citing the reported support of the **Congress** party and concerns about potential power-sharing agreements.  **D.K. Shivakumar**, Karnataka’s Deputy Chief Minister, reportedly stated that Tamil Nadu had no right to object to the project, while **T.T.V. Dhinakaran**, founder of the **AMMK**, echoed these concerns.

recent_articles.title: What else does U.S. have in store for India’s foreign policy? asks Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** general secretary Jairam Ramesh questioned **U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's** future plans for Indian foreign policy, citing Rubio's recent announcements regarding a Venezuelan presidential visit to India and the postponement of the event due to an Ebola outbreak in Africa.  Ramesh expressed concern over **Rubio's** repeated pre-emptive pronouncements on India's foreign policy decisions, including the halt of Operation Sindoor.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan elected Kerala Speaker - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan**, a senior Congress leader, was elected as the Speaker of the 16th Kerala Legislative Assembly on Friday (May 22, 2026). He won with 101 votes, defeating **A.C. Moideen** and **B.B. Gopakumar**.  The election took place after **G. Sudhakaran**, the previous Pro Tem Speaker, chose not to vote.  **V.D. Satheesan**, the Chief Minister, and **Pinarayi Vijayan**, the Leader of the Opposition, led Radhakrishnan to the Speaker's chair.

recent_articles.title: States should be allowed to conduct CET for medical courses: CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister Siddaramaiah** called for the decentralization of the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and urged **States** to have the opportunity to conduct their own Common Entrance Tests (CET) for medical courses. He argued that education is a concurrent list subject, allowing states to independently administer entrance exams for professional courses within the federal system.

recent_articles.title: DMK faces a challenge as allies set to join TVK government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **DMK**, the Secular Progressive Alliance's leader since 2017, has lost most of its pre-poll allies.  The party is now left with only **MDMK** and **Manithaneya Makkal Katchi**, who contested on its Rising Sun symbol. Additionally, the DMDK remains loyal to the TVK government. The Congress abandoned the DMK after the Assembly polls and joined Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay's Cabinet on Thursday, while the IUML and VCK are expected to join the Ministry on Friday.

recent_articles.title: Historic shift: Vijay’s Cabinet marks Tamil Nadu’s best SC representation till date - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has appointed seven members from the Scheduled Caste (SC) community to his Cabinet. This marks a significant increase in SC representation compared to previous Cabinets.  Political analyst Stalin Rajangam believes this is a positive step towards inclusivity and sets a benchmark for future governments. However, Punitha Pandiyan, former Vice President of the Tamil Nadu SC/ST Commission, argues that celebrating this development trivializes SC politics.

recent_articles.title: Congress workers clash with police in Jaipur during stir against NEET-UG paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party workers clashed with **police** in **Rajasthan** on Thursday during a protest against the NEET-UG exam paper leak.  Led by **State Congress president Govind Singh Dotasra**, the protesters demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and the dissolution of the **National Testing Agency**. The demonstrators, carrying banners and placards, were forcibly dispersed using water cannons. Some protesters suffered minor injuries.

recent_articles.title: Himachal urban poll results reflect public confidence in Congress; party united with no groupism, says CM Sukhu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, Chief Minister of **Himachal Pradesh**, attributed the Congress-backed candidates' victory in recent urban local body elections to public approval of the party's governance. He highlighted the sustained popularity despite anti-incumbency pressures and emphasized a unified effort among party workers.  He also criticized the BJP for its perceived lack of support for Himachal Pradesh, particularly regarding issues like the Revenue Deficit Grant and natural disasters. Sukhu asserted that the Congress has fulfilled its promises and exceeded expectations in delivering on commitments such as welfare schemes and reforms in education and healthcare.

recent_articles.title: From rallies to reels: political catchphrases turn dance anthems in Kolkata - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A new genre of political techno remixes has emerged in Kolkata, using catchy hooks and meme-friendly punchlines to criticize politicians. The trend began with songs like "Khela Hobe" and continues with remixed versions of "Hamba Hamba", "Mach Chor", and "File Chor". These songs often target specific individuals or parties, gaining popularity through social media platforms like Instagram and YouTube Shorts.  The use of crude humor and satirical lyrics reflects a culture of insult-flinging on social media while also expressing anger towards political leaders who abuse power.

recent_articles.title: Chennithala seeks report on parole granted to Periye murder convicts - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following protests from the families of the victims in the Periye twin murder case, **Kerala Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala** has requested a report on the parole granted to five convicts. The parole order was issued during the final phase of the previous Left Democratic Front government's tenure and the jail authorities clarified that prisoners are generally not allowed to leave during elections.  The family members of the victims plan to meet the Chief Minister and the Home Minister to file a formal complaint against the mass parole granted to the convicts.

recent_articles.title: I am from India but none of my firm partners is Indian: Attorney Rahul Reddy counters hate on social media - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Reddy**, an immigration attorney, and **Emily Neumann**, a partner at his firm, the Reddy-Neumann Brown PC, addressed concerns about the "Indians only hire Indians" narrative circulating on social media. They emphasized that while fraud exists within the H-1B program, it does not represent the entire process or all individuals involved.  **Dr. Sean Wang**, a Chinese-American assistant professor, also filed a lawsuit against **Southern Methodist University**, alleging preferential treatment of Indian employees by head of the department **Dr. Hemang Desai**.

recent_articles.title: D.K. Shivakumar challenges BJP leaders to travel by public transport daily - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister of **Karnataka**, criticized **BJP** leaders for using public transport only for photoshoots in response to the Prime Minister's call for austerity measures. He challenged them to travel by public transport daily, questioning the sincerity of their actions.  He also addressed the Prime Minister's call to abstain from buying gold and expressed his commitment to visit Delhi when called upon by **Rahul Gandhi**, Leader of the Opposition.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Cabinet expansion LIVE: Congress set to join Tamil Nadu’s first coalition government in decades - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay** is set to expand his Cabinet with the oath of office for 23 new ministers scheduled for Thursday, May 21, 2026.  The ceremony will take place at **Lok Bhavan**. The Congress party, which won five seats in the alliance led by the **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, is joining the coalition government. **Thol. Thirumavalavan**, leader of the VCK, and the **IUML** have been invited to join the Council of Ministers.

recent_articles.title: PM busy handing out candies in Italy amid economic storm at home, says Congress - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge and **Rahul Gandhi** criticized the **Narendra Modi** government's economic policies, accusing it of prioritizing publicity over addressing rising inflation, unemployment, and weakening economic indicators.  **Kharge** highlighted the increase in average debt per Indian and wealth concentration among billionaires, while **Gandhi** criticized the Prime Minister's focus on foreign trips during a time of economic distress. Congress officials also pointed to the rupee's decline, falling foreign exchange reserves, and large investor outflows as evidence of government mismanagement.

recent_articles.title: Modi, Shah are traitors who are attacking the Constitution, says Rahul at Rae Bareli meet - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress** party, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, accusing them of attacking the Constitution and supporting industrialists. He also warned of an impending economic crisis, stating that it would disproportionately affect ordinary citizens while benefiting those in power.  Gandhi unveiled a statue of Veera Pasi in Rae Bareli, highlighting his party's renewed focus on the community. He further criticized the BJP government over land acquisition policies and unemployment rates, vowing to fight for the rights of the people.

recent_articles.title: TACO abroad, boss at home: Trump may be losing against China or Iran, but still controls MAGA | World News - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump**'s foreign policy, particularly his handling of the Iran conflict, has led to a mixed bag of results. While he may be losing public support and facing congressional rebuke, he remains powerful within the Republican Party. **Trump's** tactics of intimidation have proven effective in silencing dissenters, as evidenced by the defeat of **Rep. Thomas Massie**, who lost his primary election after refusing to pledge unwavering loyalty. This strategy has also led to a decline in public approval ratings and fueled concerns about his ability to lead effectively.  Despite these challenges, **Trump** continues to hold significant sway within the Republican Party, demonstrating that loyalty trumps ideology and seniority in American politics.

recent_articles.title: Full list of Kerala Cabinet Ministers by May 17, says Satheesan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V.D. Satheesan**, the newly appointed Chief Minister of Kerala, indicated that the full list of Ministers will be presented to **Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar** by Sunday evening.  The swearing-in ceremony is scheduled for Monday at 10 a.m., with speculation surrounding potential ministerial appointments within the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**. Senior Congress leader **Ramesh Chennithala**, reportedly disgruntled over not being chosen as Chief Minister, is rumored to be joining the Cabinet as Home Minister.  **K.C. Venugopal**, an aspirant for the CM's post, also met with Mr. Chennithala in conciliatory talks. The UDF is expected to finalize its ministerial appointments after discussions with all partners.

recent_articles.title: Bidadi township: Deve Gowda announces stir against project; DKS hits back - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **H.D. Deve Gowda**, former Prime Minister, launched a campaign against the proposed Bidadi township project, claiming it targets fertile agricultural land and is driven by a "land business." He accused the **Siddaramaiah** government of facilitating this project under the guise of urban development, drawing parallels with previous satellite township projects that were withdrawn due to public opposition. **D.K. Shivakumar**, Deputy Chief Minister, countered Gowda's accusations, alleging that the Kumaraswamy family amassed wealth through real estate dealings and initiated similar projects in the past.

recent_articles.title: Athlete Swapna Barman becomes victim of poll violence, house attacked - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Swapna Barman**, an Asian Games gold medalist and Trinamool Congress candidate, reported that her property was set on fire by unidentified individuals after the 2026 West Bengal Assembly election. **Abhishek Banerjee**, a Trinamool Congress general secretary, accused **BJP** supporters of the arson attack and claimed it reflects the "violence, intimidation, and fear" directed at Trinamool supporters.  The **BJP** government has denied these allegations while **Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari** pledged to ensure the safety of those displaced by violence.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Congress demands resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders demanded the resignation of **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the **Union Education Minister**, over the NEET-UG paper leak scandal.  They accused the government of a "money-making racket" involving people linked to the ruling establishment and claimed that the incident had caused immense trauma for 22 lakh students. **Rahul Gandhi** called for the Prime Minister's intervention, while **Mallikarjun Kharge**, the Congress president, alleged that the Modi government was undermining student credibility through repeated paper leaks.  **Jairam Ramesh**, a Congress general secretary, criticized the government's lack of action and incompetence in addressing exam reforms.

recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. However, the renewed spotlight on public transit highlights a gap between policy intent and on-ground delivery.  Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. While efforts are underway to improve connectivity and funding, challenges remain, including securing approvals for expansion and procuring new train sets. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: KTR asks party leaders and BLAs to be alert during SIR - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K.T. Rama Rao**, working president of the **Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS)**, met with Assembly Constituency in-charges to discuss electoral roll revisions and membership drives. He cautioned against potential voter suppression by **Congress** and **BJP**.  He urged party members to protect voters' rights and expose the opposing parties' policies. At a separate meeting with Sanathnagar constituency activists, **KTR** stated that the BJP has minimal presence in the state and their Lok Sabha election performance was an anomaly.

recent_articles.title: NEET paper leak row: Youth Congress protests in Delhi, chief Uday Bhanu Chib detained - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian Youth Congress (IYC)** staged a protest in New Delhi demanding the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** over alleged NEET-UG question paper leaks.  Protesters, including IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib, were detained by police as they marched towards **Pradhan's** residence. The examination was cancelled on May 3rd and a re-test is scheduled for June 21st. The IYC accused the BJP-led government of creating a corrupt system that favors wealthy students while disadvantaging those from poor backgrounds.

recent_articles.title: Kerala politics LIVE: All eyes on Congress equations in Satheesan’s home turf ahead of Cabinet formation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V.D. Satheesan**, the newly designated Chief Minister-designate of the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**, has sparked speculation about potential Cabinet appointments in his stronghold of Ernakulam.  The UDF leadership met in Thiruvananthapuram on May 15th to discuss the new government's formation but did not make any final decisions regarding ministerial positions. The AICC general secretary **K.C. Venugopal** assured that differences among senior Congress leaders would be resolved amicably, paving the way for a smooth Cabinet selection process.

recent_articles.title: Fuel price hike negatively impacts economy, triggers rise in essential commodity prices: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, criticized the **Union Government’s** decision to increase petrol and diesel prices, arguing it would negatively impact the economy and ordinary citizens. He accused the government of mismanaging the economy through “inefficient governance” and “ill-conceived policies,” claiming that the fuel price hike was a breach of public trust and a misleading tactic for electoral gains.  He demanded the immediate withdrawal of the increase.

recent_articles.title: California county scam ad lawsuit adds to mounting Meta legal woes | Social Media News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Meta Platforms**, the parent company of Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads, is facing a new lawsuit from **Santa Clara County**, California. The county alleges that **Meta** knowingly profits from scam advertisements, which generated $7 billion in annual revenue, despite claiming to combat them.  The lawsuit claims that **Meta**'s system flags suspected scammers but doesn't ban them unless they are 95% certain of fraud, allowing them to continue running ads for a premium fee. The county argues this practice targets vulnerable consumers and causes financial losses for California residents, particularly seniors.  **Meta** has denied the allegations, stating that it aggressively fights scams on its platforms and removed 159 million scam advertisements last year.

recent_articles.title: Insensitivity and lack of concern, alleges Congress on Center’s silence over U.P. storm deaths - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following a powerful storm that killed at least 111 people in Uttar Pradesh, the **Uttar Pradesh** government directed Ministers to assess the situation and provide financial assistance. The **Congress** party criticized the **Union Government's** lack of response, highlighting the condolences from Russian President Vladimir Putin as evidence of their insensitivity.  The **Uttar Pradesh** Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath announced a ₹4 lakh compensation for families who lost loved ones and directed officials to ensure relief for farmers and livestock owners.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court closes plea of Goa Congress leader after his death from snakebite - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** closed the plea of deceased **Ketan Bhatikar**, a Congress candidate for the Ponda Assembly seat, challenging a Bombay High Court order cancelling the bypoll.  Bhatikar died from a snakebite on Thursday and his lawyer requested the court to leave the larger question of law open while closing the proceedings. The High Court had earlier canceled the bypoll citing violation of the Representation of the People Act as less than one year remained in the term of the Assembly.

recent_articles.title: Telangana Congress raises concerns over SIR process - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC)** met **Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy** on May 15, 2026, to express concerns and suggest improvements for the proposed Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The party urged a phased and carefully planned revision process over one-and-a-half to two years, citing concerns about the scale of the exercise and the lack of major elections scheduled in the near future.  They also requested specific measures like providing voter lists from 2002 and 2025, extending objection periods, ensuring physical notice before deletion, conducting proper field verification, and addressing allegations of irregularities in the pre-SIR mapping process. The Congress party also demanded safeguards for migrant voters and special awareness programs for weaker sections.

recent_articles.title: Will lead to further inflation, growth estimates will be lowered considerably: Congress on fuel hike - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Congress** criticized the **Modi government** for increasing petrol and diesel prices, claiming it will exacerbate inflation and lower growth estimates. The party's general secretary, **Jairam Ramesh**, stated that despite falling international oil prices for years, domestic prices remained high, leading to consumer exploitation.  Fuel prices were hiked by ₹3 per litre each on Friday (May 15, 2026), marking the first increase in over four years and coming after a period of price freezes. The hike was attributed to rising global crude prices triggered by the West Asia conflict and is expected to impact inflation and growth estimates.

recent_articles.title: Compromised PM didn't sign trade deal with U.S., but a bargain for Adani's release: Rahul - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi** accused **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** of negotiating a trade deal with the U.S. to secure the release of billionaire businessman **Gautam Adani**.  The **U.S.** government agreed to settle a lawsuit against **Adani**, who was accused of bribery in connection with a solar energy project. Congress general secretary in-charge communications **Jairam Ramesh** criticized the deal, suggesting it was a "bargain" for **Adani's release".

recent_articles.title: Petrol and diesel prices hike LIVE: Government hikes price by ₹3 per litre, Congress lashes out - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Oil-marketing companies** increased petrol and diesel prices by ₹3 across all variants on Friday, May 15, 2026, in response to pressure on fuel supplies due to the ongoing West Asia conflict. **The Centre** implemented this price hike nationwide, affecting both regular and premium petrol and diesel products, as well as high-octane options. Petrol prices rose to ₹97.77 per litre in Delhi and ₹107.97 per litre in Jaipur, while diesel prices climbed to ₹90.67 per litre in Delhi and ₹93.23 per litre in Jaipur.

recent_articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks rise after AI rally spurs US gauges - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Stocks rose across Asia and in the US, driven by optimism surrounding artificial intelligence and strong corporate earnings. The **MSCI Asia Pacific Index** gained for a sixth consecutive week, while futures for the **Nasdaq 100 Index** remained unchanged after hitting an all-time high.  The **two-year yield** reached its highest level since June, while Brent crude prices climbed to around $106 a barrel. President **Donald Trump's** visit to China is expected to be a key focus for investors in the coming days.

recent_articles.title: Congress leader and former Jharkhand Minister, Alamgir Alam, walks out of jail - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Alamgir Alam**, a former Jharkhand minister, was released on bail from the Birsa Munda Central Jail in Ranchi after the Supreme Court granted relief in his money laundering case.  The **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** arrested **Alam** and his OSD, Sanjiv Kumar Lal, in 2024 following the seizure of nearly ₹32.20 crore from a flat linked to them. The Congress party fielded Alam's wife, Nishat Alam, as their candidate for the Pakur Assembly constituency in the 2024 elections, where she won. **Babulal Marandi**, the Leader of Opposition in the Jharkhand Assembly, criticized the celebration surrounding Alam's release, stating that it was premature and did not equate to an acquittal. He emphasized that the trial is ongoing and the legal process will continue until a final verdict is reached.

recent_articles.title: CM Fadnavis’ bike ride draws Opposition ire - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, rode a motorbike to Vidhan Bhavan after Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** called for austerity measures. The move drew criticism from the Opposition who urged Ministers to use public transport instead.  **Sharad Pawar**, NCP SP president, questioned the timing of the austerity measures and demanded an all-party meeting with the Prime Minister. He also criticized the State Government ministers' language towards **Rahul Gandhi**, the Leader of Opposition in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: AAP, Congress raises concern over SIR in Punjab ahead of 2027 Assembly polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** issued a notification for a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Punjab and other states, prompting concerns from the **Indian National Congress** and the **Aam Aadmi Party**. The SIR exercise will involve door-to-door visits by both-level officers (BLOs) from June 25 to July 24, 2026.  The **AAP** alleged that constitutional institutions under the **BJP** rule are being misused for political advantage, while the **Congress** expressed concerns about the timing of the exercise ahead of the upcoming Punjab assembly elections. The **Haryana Chief Electoral Officer** announced a similar SIR campaign in Haryana with a qualifying date of July 1, 2026.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal government mandates singing Vande Mataram in all State-run schools during morning assembly - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, West Bengal Chief Minister, issued an order mandating the singing of **Vande Mataram** in all state-run schools during school assembly prayers. This order overrides a previous directive requiring schools to sing the state song, **Banglar Mati, Banglar Jol**. The move comes amidst political tensions surrounding the national song's recognition and follows a BJP campaign highlighting alleged neglect by the Trinamool Congress government.

recent_articles.title: ED arrests Kolkata Police DC Shantanu Sinha Biswas in money laundering case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** officials arrested **Shantanu Sinha Biswas**, Deputy Commissioner of Kolkata Police, on Thursday for his alleged involvement in land grabbing and money laundering linked to businessman **Sona Pappu**.  The arrest follows repeated summons by the ED and a lookout notice issued against him for failing to appear. The investigation is ongoing, with the ED seeking information from the West Bengal Police regarding Biswas' current deployment. This marks the second high-profile arrest by the ED since the change of regime in West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Singareni’s past glory will be restored through new mines, new jobs: Minister Vivek Venkataswamy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. G. Vivek Venkataswamy**, **Minister for Labour, Mines & Geology**, emphasized the state government's commitment to restoring the glory of **Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL)** through new coal mines and employment opportunities. He highlighted the Ramakrishnapur Opencast (RKP OC) Phase-2 project's potential to create 5,000 jobs and urged collaboration between workers and officials for SCCL's growth.  **A. Revanth Reddy**, **Chief Minister**, is aware of the issue regarding employee perks, while **Gaddam Vamsi Krishna**, **Peddapalli MP**, is advocating for a ₹10,000 monthly pension for retired SCCL workers in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Mamata dons lawyer’s robe, Calcutta HC directs police to ensure safe return of victims affected by violence - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, former West Bengal Chief Minister, appeared before the Calcutta High Court on Thursday, May 14, 2026, alleging police inaction during post-election violence.  She claimed that she is unable to file complaints in person and has been forced to lodge them online. The court directed the **West Bengal police** to ensure safe returns for those illegally evicted from their homes or businesses due to post-election violence.  The Trinamool Congress welcomed the intervention, while protests erupted from a section of lawyers who chanted "chor chor" (thief thief) slogans.

recent_articles.title: Watch: Congress ends suspense: V. D. Satheesan to be next Kerala CM | Above the Fold | 14.05.2026 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kerala Congress** named V.D. Satheesan as its new Chief Minister after weeks of internal discussions, ending months of uncertainty. recent_articles.title: Is your portfolio FII-proof? 7 stocks Jefferies says can defy the $53 billion foreign selloff - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Jefferies** analysts have identified a shift in ownership dynamics within the Indian stock market, with foreign institutional investors (FIIs) selling off shares while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) are buying more. This trend has led to an increase in domestic ownership and a potential cushion against further FII selling pressure.  The brokerage highlighted seven companies as "domestic favourites" where DIIs have significantly increased their shareholding, suggesting these stocks may be less vulnerable to foreign selling. However, **Jefferies** also identified 15 stocks with high FII-DII ratios that remain more susceptible to further foreign outflows, particularly in sectors like financials and consumer goods. Despite this trend, global investors remain underweight India compared to the MSCI Emerging Markets benchmark, indicating a potential for sustained foreign selling pressure.

recent_articles.title: Kerala’s Chief Minister-designate V.D. Satheesan holds out an olive branch to other contenders for the top post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V.D. Satheesan**, the newly designated Chief Minister-designate for **Kerala**, expressed gratitude to **K.C. Venugopal** and **Ramesh Chennithala**, who were considered for the top post, while also acknowledging the contributions of other leaders within the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**.  He attributed the 10-day delay in selecting a Chief Minister to the "glut of choices" and emphasized that the final decision rests with the **Congress's high command**. He assured the people of **Kerala** of progress and development under his leadership, promising to work closely with the **UDF** to form the government.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM announcement LIVE: Congress names V.D. Satheesan as Kerala CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **AICC** announced **V.D. Satheesan** as the Chief Minister designate of Kerala, ending a ten-day period of uncertainty following the May 4th election results. The announcement was made by **Ajay Maken**, **Mukul Wasnik**, and **Deepa Dasmunshi** at the AICC Office.  The Congress will now proceed to form the government in the state after securing the majority.

recent_articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks, US futures climb on tech optimism - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **US** stocks closed at record highs on Wednesday, boosted by strong corporate earnings and expectations of sustained growth fueled by AI spending. **Cisco Systems Inc.**'s strong outlook lifted Nasdaq 100 futures contracts.  **Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.** and **Tencent Holdings Ltd.** missed revenue estimates, while the offshore yuan is experiencing its best winning streak since 2017. Investors are closely watching geopolitical developments in Iran and the summit between President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping for potential market impacts. recent_articles.title: 24x7 control rooms for disaster management to be set up in Ernakulam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the activation of **Taluk Emergency Operation Centres (TEOCs)** by May 20th to prepare for the monsoon season. The district has received a ₹5 crore disaster relief fund from the **State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)** and additional funds for desilting rivers, cleaning canals, and installing geobags along the Chellanam coast.  Local bodies have been tasked with identifying potential relief camps and furnishing equipment for emergency response.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal CM gives sanction to CBI to prosecute officials in several scams - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, West Bengal Chief Minister, granted permission to the **CBI** to prosecute officials involved in teacher's recruitment, municipality recruitment, and cooperative scams.  He stated that these investigations were previously withheld by the previous Trinamool Congress government due to corruption concerns. The move is part of a "zero tolerance" policy against corruption adopted by his BJP-led administration.  The Chief Minister also lifted a ban on potato sales to other states, citing a bumper crop and falling prices.

recent_articles.title: BJP, Congress attack SP over party spokesperson’s remark on Brahmins; FIR registered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajkumar Bhati**, a spokesperson for the **Samajwadi Party**, faced backlash after a video surfaced showing him making derogatory remarks against the Brahmin community.  **Pankaj Chaudhary**, the state BJP president and Union Minister, condemned the comments as "indecent" and said they reflected the SP's "divide and rule" mentality. Deputy Chief Minister **Brajesh Pathak** called the remarks "disgusting" and a reflection of the SP's character.  **Ajay Rai**, the state Congress chief, demanded disciplinary action against Bhati and an apology from **Akhilesh Yadavji**, the SP chief. A case was filed against Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: Congress unveils ‘Bhu Guarantee’ in Karnataka - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **D.K. Shivakumar**, the **Deputy Chief Minister** of Karnataka, unveiled the "sixth guarantee" — Bhu Guarantee — which includes a 60% discount on conversion fees for B-Khata to A-Khata properties within Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) limits. The scheme also offers a 50% reduction in regularisation costs for buildings constructed before 2008 on BDA land, and a 15% setback relaxation as per the Town Planning Act. These announcements come amidst discussions about holding civic elections in Bengaluru this year.  The government aims to encourage property conversions and regularizations, but faces challenges with low application rates due to high fees previously associated with these processes.

recent_articles.title: Pete Hegseth: Hegseth pushes Trump’s $1.5 trillion defense budget for 2027 as Congress presses Pentagon over Iran war costs - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pete Hegseth**, **US defense secretary**, defended President Donald Trump's proposed $1.5 trillion military budget before Congress, facing questions about the rising cost of the Iran war and its impact on military readiness.  Lawmakers expressed concerns about the conflict's expanding cost, with Pentagon officials reporting that it has now reached nearly $29 billion. **Hegseth** acknowledged efforts to increase weapons production but maintained that the administration is not straining US weapon supplies. The proposed budget includes significant funding for missile defense, aircraft procurement, drone technologies, and shipbuilding.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu Assembly session LIVE: CM Vijay moves resolution seeking confidence vote - The Hindu

recent_articles.title: Opposition parties are spreading panic over PM’s voluntary, precautionary appeal: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** criticized opposition parties, accusing them of spreading misinformation about Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**’s call for voluntary gold purchases and foreign travel restrictions.  **BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia** stated that the government has taken measures to protect India's economy and there is no shortage of essential commodities.

recent_articles.title: Supreme Court to hear ED plea against bail granted to accused in West Bengal coal scam case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** agreed to hear the **Enforcement Directorate’s** (ED) appeal against the grant of anticipatory bail to Anup Majee, accused of leading a coal mining scam in West Bengal. The **ED** claims that Mr. Majee operated with the “active” assistance of several leaders from the **All India Trinamool Congress**.  The court sought Mr. Majee’s response to the agency's plea challenging a June 2025 order granting him bail in a money laundering case registered in 2020.

recent_articles.title: Cong MLCs meet Surjewala, seeks clarity on leadership issue - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **MLCs** from the **Congress** government in Karnataka met with **Randeep Singh Surjewala**, a **Congress** general secretary, in New Delhi to discuss potential leadership changes. The MLCs requested an early clarification on the issue and also demanded that at least five members be included in the state cabinet if there is a reshuffle.

recent_articles.title: Free vaccination for cervical cancer until May 31 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **District Collector G. Priyanka** announced the final phase of the HPV vaccination campaign against cervical cancer in the district, urging all eligible girls to receive the vaccine before May 31, 2026.  The campaign aims to vaccinate a total of 22,358 girls aged 14 and under, with only 34% currently vaccinated as of the current date. The vaccination facility will cease operation after this deadline.

recent_articles.title: BJP targets DMK leader Udhayanidhi Stalin over Sanatana Dharma remarks - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** condemned **Udhayanidhi Stalin**, a DMK leader, for his remarks on Sanatana Dharma in the Tamil Nadu Assembly.  **G. Kishan Reddy**, Union Minister for Coal and Mines, accused the DMK of "poisonous politics" and "anti-Hindu rhetoric." The BJP also criticized the Congress party's support for Stalin's comments and questioned **Vijay**, the newly elected Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, on his silence regarding the issue.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: ST delegation meets CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, has promised to convene an all-party meeting to discuss the inclusion of a 56% reservation matrix in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution.  He also assured **V.S. Ugrappa**, former MP and leader of the Samana Manaskara Vedike, that he will take an all-party delegation to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to advocate for this legislation. The state government has been working to overturn a legal stay on the 56% reservation, with legal experts being consulted and a special leave petition potentially filed in the Supreme Court.

recent_articles.title: The legacy of women Ministers in Tamil Nadu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **C. Joseph Vijay**, the new Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, was sworn in alongside **Keerthana**, who won from the Sivakasi assembly constituency, marking a significant milestone for women in state politics.  While social media erroneously claimed she was the first woman Cabinet member, women have served as Ministers in the Tamil Nadu Cabinet for decades, with the first instance occurring in 1946 under **T. Prakasam**. Since then, women have been consistently included in the state's Cabinets.

recent_articles.title: What happened at Phuket cafe where Indian tourists fainted one by one 'for no obvious reason'? 1 dead - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A 26-year-old Indian tourist, **Kushagra Agarwal**, died at a Phuket cafe after collapsing on May 9th.  **The Indian embassy** is providing support to his family and is working with Thai authorities investigating the incident. Three other members of the group also fainted at the same cafe, one in a coma and two requiring further treatment. Police are looking into possible illicit substances or alcohol as a contributing factor but have not released any findings.

recent_articles.title: AICC begins consultations with Kerala leaders in New Delhi to decide on Congress’ CM candidate - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, **Sonia Gandhi**, and **Mallikarjun Kharge** met with top Kerala leaders in New Delhi on Tuesday to discuss the selection of a Chief Minister nominee for the state. The high command is seeking bipartisan support from former KPCC presidents, Congress MLAs-elect, and other key figures to restore organizational stability after the party's recent victory.  The meeting considered several potential candidates, including **K.C. Venugopal**, **V.D. Satheesan**, **Ramesh Chennithala**, and **Priyanka Gandhi Vadra**.  **K. Muraleedharan**, a KPCC insider, stated that the high command would consider popular opinion in addition to legislative party numbers when making their decision.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool’s land policy delayed West Bengal border fencing: MHA’s 2023 affidavit in Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)** stated in a Supreme Court affidavit that the former **Trinamool Congress** government's slow and complex Direct Land Purchase Policy hindered land acquisition for border fencing along the Bangladesh border. The **BJP** government, after assuming power, announced plans to transfer land to the **Border Security Force (BSF)** within 45 days.  The West Bengal government has handed over 78 km of border land to the BSF in the past three years, while 121 km remains to be transferred. The Calcutta High Court is currently reviewing the applicability and feasibility of acquiring land using Section 40 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act (LARR Act), 2013.

recent_articles.title: ‘Bangla Pokkho’ founder Garga Chatterjee arrested for spreading EVM misinformation - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Garga Chatterjee**, founder of the pro-Bengali advocacy organization **Bangla Pokkho**, was arrested by the **Kolkata Police** on Tuesday for allegedly spreading misinformation about EVM manipulation during the recent West Bengal Assembly elections. The arrest followed a complaint filed by the District Election Officer of Kolkata North and comes after Mr. Chatterjee's previous arrest in 2022 for alleged community-based hate speech.  Former Trinamool Congress Minister **Sujit Bose** was also sent to 10-day ED custody on Tuesday, accused of illegally recommending candidates for South Dum Dum Municipality positions in exchange for financial benefits. Newly appointed West Bengal Sports Minister **Nisith Pramanik** has requested the file related to the Lionel Messi event in Kolkata and plans to take action if necessary.

recent_articles.title: BJP MLA Tapas Roy sworn in as Pro-tem Speaker of West Bengal Assembly - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Tapas Roy**, a senior Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader and MLA from Maniktala, was sworn in as the Pro-Tem Speaker of the West Bengal Assembly on Tuesday, May 12, 2026. **Suvendu Adhikari**, the Chief Minister, attended the ceremony. The oath-taking of other MLAs will be held on Wednesday and Thursday, with the election for Speaker scheduled for Friday.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly polls 2026: IUML growing restive over Congress delaying CM decision - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian Union Muslim League (IUML)**, a key force in the **United Democratic Front (UDF)**'s victory in the April 9 Assembly election, is facing discontent over the delay in finalizing the Chief Minister.  **IUML** leaders have expressed concern about the perceived casual attitude of some **Congress** leaders, particularly **Mathew Kuzhalnadan** and **M.M. Hassan**, who they believe are overlooking the party's contribution to the UDF's success. The IUML leadership is calling for a resolution to the uncertainty by Wednesday at a meeting with **State president Syed Sadikali Shihab Thangal**.  The prolonged delay has led to public disappointment and concerns about the spirit of the people's mandate.

recent_articles.title: NSUI protests after NTA cancels NEET-UG 2026 over paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A massive protest organized by the **National Students' Union of India (NSUI)** erupted outside the **Shastri Bhawan** on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, demanding justice for students alleging a paper leak in the NEET-UG exam.  The protest saw members of the **Congress party's student wing** participate, holding signs and slogans criticizing the government's handling of the situation. The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** canceled the examination following investigations by the **Rajasthan Special Operations Group (SOG) and the CBI**.  The NSUI accused the central government of failing to protect students and demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and a ban on the **NTA**.

recent_articles.title: Samsung, SK Hynix earn more profit than all of listed India Inc - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Google**, **Microsoft**, and **Amazon**'s increased demand for chips has led to significant profits for **SK Hynix** and **Samsung**.  Both Korean chip giants have reported substantial profit growth over the past nine quarters, with **SK Hynix** returning to profitability in the March 2024 quarter after a period of losses. Their combined revenue was less than one-fourth of **India Inc's** quarterly revenue, highlighting their high profit margins compared to Indian companies.
